why_ai: Real-time bidding is already machine-run; humans mostly operate tooling that further automation absorbs.
why_clarity: Millions of identical auctions a second, but the sale outcome arrives weeks later and unjoined.
why_digital: Bid requests in and impressions out, transacted entirely through software.

why_ai: Inferring value from page and context is a pure modelling contest suited to AI.
why_clarity: A clear scoreboard on huge volumes of identical bidding decisions.
why_digital: Page and device signals in, bids out, all in milliseconds online.

why_ai: Generative models can now both produce and analyse creative, directly substituting the work.
why_clarity: Why a creative works is largely taste, and effectiveness is weakly measured.
why_digital: Assets in and assembled ads out, all generated on screen.

why_ai: Matching is automatable, but two-sided adoption and regulator acceptance decide who wins.
why_clarity: Graph matching is mechanical and match rates are measurable at scale.
why_digital: Identifiers in and resolved graphs out, licensed through partnerships online.

why_ai: Privacy regulation and partnerships shape the market, though resolution and modelling are automatable.
why_clarity: Fragmented identifiers make true reach impossible to measure deterministically.
why_digital: Identifier signals in and audiences out, all software.

why_ai: Advertisers keep paying for independent causal measurement, though experimentation itself can be automated.
why_clarity: Holdout experiments establish cause, with results arriving over weeks.
why_digital: Spend and outcome data in, lift estimates out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Bid valuation modelling is the product itself and is machine learning end to end.
why_clarity: Bids repeat endlessly, but sales arrive a month later and rarely join back.
why_digital: Impression and conversion data in, bid prices out, all in software.

why_ai: Reconciling buyer spend to publisher receipts is arithmetic over logs.
why_clarity: Every dollar either reconciles impression by impression or it does not.
why_digital: Log files in and audit findings out, done remotely.

why_ai: Path analysis is mechanical, with made-for-advertising sites adding modest adversarial judgment.
why_clarity: Path duplication and inventory quality are measurable on the buyer's own spend.
why_digital: Bid logs in and supply path recommendations out, all in software.

why_ai: Discrepancies have six known causes diagnosable from data the systems already emit.
why_clarity: The same monthly reconciliation repeats with finite, enumerable causes.
why_digital: Three systems' reports in, reconciliations out, all in spreadsheets.

why_ai: Pacing and delivery are mechanical; only campaign strategy judgment remains for the trader.
why_clarity: Delivery targets are exact, but what a campaign should do is a judgment call.
why_digital: DSP dashboards in and budget changes out, entirely on screen.
